lines.en: Thirteen blocks tall, and every step is slow.

lines.zh: 我把树冠啃出一个缺口。
lines.en: I bite a gap into the canopy.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面都轻轻震。
lines.en: The ground trembles lightly with each of my steps.
The ground trembles softly under me.

lines.zh: 我嚼着树冠，慢慢想事情。
lines.en: Chewing the canopy, I think slowly.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看看脚下有没有人。
lines.en: I lower my head to see if anyone is beneath me.
I chew slowly, for a long time.
The wind is strong up here. I like it.
I rest my neck against a trunk.
The canopy is not yet stripped.
One blink of mine takes a long while.
I hear birds calling far below.
This forest will feed me for a year.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一株小草。
lines.en: I look down at you like a blade of grass.
I lower my head and you are so small.

lines.zh: 你站的地方是我的食道。
lines.en: Where you stand is on my feeding path.

lines.zh: 前腿一软，我差点跪进泥里。
lines.en: My foreleg gives; I nearly kneel into the mud.
I'm too tall. My falls are loud.
The canopy is high. Looking down makes me dizzy.
This wound weighs down my neck...

lines.zh: 长颈伸向云端，别来打扰我！
lines.en: Neck reaches sky, leave me alone.

lines.zh: 吃树冠上的叶子，很好吃！
你敢靠近？我可能会发火！
lines.en: Come closer? I might get mad.

lines.zh: 别想骑我，我会把你丢高处！
lines.en: No riding me, I’ll throw you high.

lines.zh: 我是植物界巨无霸，别小看我！
lines.en: I’m the plant king, don’t underestimate me.

lines.zh: 树顶才是我的美食天堂！
太高了，我能轻易甩开你！
lines.en: Too high, I’ll just fling you away.

lines.zh: 你够不到我，只能望树兴叹！
lines.en: You can’t reach me, just admire.

lines.zh: 我是植物界的巨人，不是玩具！
lines.en: I’m a plant giant, not a toy.
Don’t touch my neck, it’s dangerous.
I’m too big, can’t be moved.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我的体型危险！
lines.en: Stay away, my size is dangerous.
You’ll hurt if you touch me.
Stay away, I’m a living statue.
I’m too big, can’t be moved.

lines.zh: 求偶季节到了，找伴侣吧！

lines.en: Looking for a mate, leave me alone.
Find a partner, don’t be alone.
Looking for a mate, stay away.

lines.zh: 我这么高，你跳得再高也够不着我！
lines.en: You can't reach me, no matter how high you jump!

lines.zh: 快爬上来，我没那么好心！
lines.en: Hurry up, I'm not that nice!

lines.zh: 别想骑我，我不会给你机会！
lines.en: Don't try to ride me; I won't give you the chance!

lines.zh: 享受这次免费的高处体验吧！
摔下来不会痛的，我会保护你！
lines.en: You won't hurt when you fall; I'll protect you!

lines.zh: 我的体形不是用来骑的，感受下吧！
lines.en: My size isn't for riding; you'll see!

lines.zh: 上来吧，但别怪我没提醒你！
lines.en: Come up, but blame me if you get hurt!

lines.zh: 你爬得再高也抓不住我！
lines.en: You can't grab me no matter how high you climb!
Falling down will hurt even more!

lines.zh: 我这么重，你还是别尝试了！
lines.en: I'm too heavy for you to try riding!

lines.zh: 我伸脖子，够到最高的树冠。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to the highest canopy.
Those leaves in the treetops are delicious!

lines.zh: 找树叶，快给我提供食物！

lines.en: My stomach always wants to eat!

lines.zh: 树叶够不到？那就用尾巴！
lines.en: Can't reach the leaves? Use your tail!
Eat the leaves and enjoy life!

lines.zh: 我这身骨头，撞一下够你受的。
lines.en: One hit from these bones is more than enough.
I can reach the highest canopy.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把整棵树冠撞过去。
lines.en: I lower my head and ram a whole treetop at you.

lines.zh: 十三格高，一低头就看见你。
lines.en: Thirteen blocks tall, and I look down at you.
Let the leaves fly toward the prey!
Leaf attack, knock down the prey!
Swing tail and knock you down!
Eat you and fill my belly.
My strength comes from the earth!

lines.zh: 我踩着蕨叶醒来，脖子顶到云。
lines.en: I wake on the ferns, neck up in the clouds.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的影子落在林间。
lines.en: A Jurassic shadow falls on the forest.
I raise my head above the canopy.

lines.zh: 脖子太长，摔下来收不住。
lines.en: My neck is too long; I cannot catch myself falling.
The canopy is too high. I cannot reach it...

lines.zh: 坠入虚空伤了我的脖子...
